method: Each diagram is the default node at the stack pin already on this page. C++ arrows are target_link_libraries between the node's own libraries, including vendored libraries the line counter already marks, and not libraries outside the tree. Rust arrows are workspace crates the default node binary reaches. A dependency is a workspace path, or a dependency whose name is a workspace member. Optional dependencies stay off except florestad, whose default feature json-rpc turns on floresta-compact-filters and floresta-rpc. libbitcoin-system is one library, so an arrow is a module under src including another at least twice. btcd arrows are package imports. A set of packages that import each other is one box. An arrow a longer path already covers is left off the drawing and kept in the table. No line counts.

rows.headline: bitcoind links the node and the wallet. Both link bitcoin_common. libbitcoinkernel is not linked by bitcoind.
rows.caption: Arrows point from a CMake target to a target it links, read from target_link_libraries. Box names drop a bitcoin_ prefix. A vendored box is a path the line counter already treats as vendored. An arrow a longer path already covers is left off the drawing. The table lists every link. libbitcoinkernel is in the tree and is not linked by bitcoind. bitcoin-qt is off in the default build. Boost and SQLite are outside the tree, so they are not boxes.

rows.headline: The bitcoin-rs binary depends on the node crate. The node crate sits above rpc, p2p, and the chain crates, and those sit above primitives.
rows.caption: Arrows point from a workspace crate to a workspace crate it depends on, in the default node binary. Box names drop the shared prefix. Dependencies outside the workspace are not boxes. Test, bench, fuzz, and tools the binary does not reach are not drawn. An arrow a longer path already covers is left off the drawing. The table lists every workspace dependency.

rows.headline: The satd binary sits above the interface crates, and those sit on the node crate. The node crate depends on consensus, the indexes, and policy.
rows.caption: Arrows point from a workspace crate to a workspace crate it depends on, in the default node binary. Box names drop the shared prefix. Dependencies outside the workspace are not boxes. Test, bench, fuzz, and tools the binary does not reach are not drawn. An arrow a longer path already covers is left off the drawing. The table lists every workspace dependency. Optional dependencies are not drawn.

rows.headline: libbitcoin-system is one library. wallet and config include chain, chain includes crypto, and crypto includes hash, data, and math.
rows.caption: An arrow is one module under src including another, and only a pair that occurs at least twice. A single include does not set the direction. filter never does, so it is not drawn. An arrow a longer path already covers is left off the drawing. The table lists every pair that met the count. secp256k1 is not a separate library in this build.

rows.headline: hornetnode links hornetnodelib, and hornetnodelib links hornetlib.
rows.caption: Arrows are target_link_libraries in src at this pin. hornetlib is the consensus and protocol sources. hornetnodelib is the controller and the network. liburing is outside the tree, so it is not a box.

rows.headline: florestad depends on floresta-node. The node crate sits above electrum, mempool, and wire, and those sit above the chain crate.
rows.caption: Arrows point from a workspace crate to a workspace crate it depends on, in the default node binary. Box names drop the shared prefix. Dependencies outside the workspace are not boxes. Test, bench, fuzz, and tools the binary does not reach are not drawn. An arrow a longer path already covers is left off the drawing. The table lists every workspace dependency. florestad's default feature json-rpc turns on floresta-compact-filters and floresta-rpc, so those two arrows are included. floresta-common is the workspace member of that name.

rows.headline: rbitcoin-node sits above esplora, electrum, ibd, rpc, and sv2. Those sit above net, and net sits above mempool and query.
rows.caption: Arrows point from a workspace crate to a workspace crate it depends on, in the default node binary. Box names drop the shared prefix. Dependencies outside the workspace are not boxes. Test, bench, fuzz, and tools the binary does not reach are not drawn. An arrow a longer path already covers is left off the drawing. The table lists every workspace dependency.

rows.headline: The btcd process imports netsync. netsync imports mempool and peer, and those import blockchain.
rows.caption: An arrow is an import of another package in this repository, from the btcd process and the packages it reaches. address, btcutil, chaincfg, and txscript import each other, so they are one box and the arrows between them are not drawn. psbt and rpcclient are not imported by that process, so they are not drawn. An arrow a longer path already covers is left off the drawing. The table lists every remaining import.
